method: Compare known receipt fields only, matched by unique existing operation reference, exact log timestamp, collection and receipt versions; no timestamp-only or D1-row join.
limits: Known-field comparison, not complete raw-log equality or authentication of provider captures.
Unknown receipt versions and ambiguous/invalid pairs cannot supply accepted matches.
Observed differences do not locate their cause within provider ingestion, storage, API, UI or export.
No raw values, arbitrary field names, operation/provider identifiers or request context appear in this aggregate.
